lines.x: Every task has been entered according to its deadline, and the system has produced the optimal processing order. Let us begin, Doctor. I will verify the results once you are finished.

Some go there hoping to achieve a feat no lesser than 'the discovery of Bolívar.' Others merely use exploration as a pretext to survey whatever bountiful treasure the jungle might hide. And you, Doctor? For what reason did you step into that enchanting sea of trees?
玻利瓦尔是一片被祝福过的土地，其物产的丰富程度可能远超您的想象。相信我，博士，越是荒僻的市集，它的色彩就越是绚丽。毕竟在那些地方，凡是会动的东西，都能卖……也都能吃。

This drone is not merely a weapon—it is a translator, transcribing real matter and energy into computer-readable data. You are familiar with this use of Originium as well, are you not? Silence? Heh, of course. I keep forgetting that knowledge and technology have always had borders of their own.

Try deciphering this computer's passcode. You might just find within it a way to build 'the weapon that destroys all weapons'—assuming, of course, that such a weapon truly exists. Do you believe it does?

Miss.Christine is an amiable companion—she is a Rhodes Island operator just as I am, so how could she not be? Oh? You see something in me that resembles that lady? Hehe. Would you tell me what it is you saw, Doctor?
桌上这枚勋章……嗯，我见过她。那孩子有一面坚实的盾和一颗纯净的心，除此之外……抱歉，我知道的并不比您多。但，丛林会记住每一缕闪光的灵魂，终有一天您会再见到她。

You are the most silent scholar I have ever met. And rightly so—a silver tongue belongs to politicians; for a researcher, what has always mattered is only the pair of eyes that can see the essence of all things. In your view, Doctor, does a pure, ideal, wholly undistorted observation truly exist?

On my first day arriving in Tecoma with my father, the town's hounds bit to death the little beckbeast I had brought from home. Yes, in Bolívar such things happen every moment of every day. But for a child, that alone is enough to become one real and hopeless misfortune of their childhood, wouldn't you say?
睡着了？呼……真是毫无防备呢。出于这份信任，就不偷看您的档案咯。
There is no need to look at me like that, Doctor. I am only an ordinary Originium technology researcher. Still suspicious? Hehe. Have the operators in HR not already vetted my file?
暂停。画面中的武器……呵，这群军火大亨还真是一如既往地毫无底线。
我该用什么来回应这份嘉奖？绝密的信息，还是……非凡的忠心？
A promotion again? Hehe. There is no need to go to such trouble to give me these pretty lumps of metal. Medals are of no use whatsoever, Doctor.
Combat data synchronized.
The system has recommended suitable personnel for this operation. Would you care to consult it?
Theoretically viable. Beginning field verification.
I shall intervene.
Data, no anomalies.
Channel, no anomalies.
Coordinates, no anomalies.
Orders, no anomalies.
Will you be that special sample?
Path planning complete. Target locked.
It is my regret to inform you—your data is about to be deleted.
My apologies. If it is possible, you will appear in the acknowledgments of my paper.
将军们梦寐以求的“胜利”……博士，我真想知道，您现在的表情会不会和他们一样？
罗德岛的博士……呵呵，一位卓越的研究员，同时也是一名危险的战争艺术家。
There is still room for improvement.
Attrition is unavoidable. You need not blame yourself for it.
A most efficient production line.
I shall treat that as a naughty child's prank, Doctor.
Every single interaction between us is automatically recorded by the system, you know, Doctor.
Arknights.

In Tecoma, the researchers would gather on holidays as well, chatting about whose child made the team, which bar hired a new bartender, small things like that. You see, the daily life of 'geniuses' is not all formulas and data. So today, go and talk with everyone a little more, Doctor.
Inspiration needs new space; you will never find it shut away in a laboratory—what I mean is, it is time we went out for a walk, Doctor.

No need for suspicion—that email really was addressed to you, Doctor. It is safe, it carries no virus, and it will not steal any data from your terminal—yes, I simply wished to wish you a happy birthday. You see? The two of us could be a little more candid with each other, could we not?
您应当明白，您所追寻的东西就同那些政治新人口中“结束一切战争”的竞选宣言一样，几乎不可能实现……流沙中垒塔，海水里耕种。呵，真是群天真又迷人的家伙。
